narrative.details: Commander Ashlam Valorfist has sent out a call for a paladin of your purity and valor, adventurer.  You can find him at Chillwind Camp in the southern part of the Western Plaguelands.  Seek him and aid in his cause for the Light!
narrative.objectives: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText: Very well, Champion! Let's see what you're made of.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 52, 14,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Chillwind Point
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.

quests.name: Dispelling Evil
quests.objectiveText: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Inert Scourgestones
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.

quests.name: Forging the Mightstone
quests.objectiveText: Bring the voodoo feathers to Ashlam Valorfist.
